description: Good decision: in reader/main.rs the two security guards (missing signing key, auth dev-mode on non-loopback) both run before TcpListener::bind. The process exits before any socket is opened, so there is no window in which the server is reachable but unguarded. The same ordering holds in mail/main.rs: the ActivityPub signature guard and the auth dev-mode guard both fire before run_server is called.
title: DECISION: dev-mode guards placed before socket bind
